simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אַלְלַי (H480) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: inj.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אַלְלַי (ʼalᵉlay) means alas! First listed occurrence: Job 10 15.

definitions.full: H480. alelay אַלְלַי interjection (probably onomatopoetic: compare , אָלָה , to wail , woe! Di 718 ) alas! woe! followed by לִי to me Micah 7:1 ; Job 10:15 .
